paper_summary: Spanish-language PhD thesis (UPM, 2021) on aluminium syntactic foams (ASF / metal matrix syntactic foams) made by mechanically-assisted gravity melt infiltration (DIM) of an AA6063 (Al-Mg-Si) matrix into beds of porous nodules. Two series were produced: C-ASF, reinforced with ~11.5 mm expanded-clay (Arlita/LECA) nodules infiltrated at 700 C, and T-ASF, reinforced with in-house 8-9 mm foamed commercially-pure aluminium nodules (TPM, foamed with marble/CaCO3) infiltrated at 750 C. Samples were annealed (AA6063-O) and compressed quasi-statically (1e-3 1/s, 20 C) per ISO 13314:2011; T-ASF gave higher quasi-elastic gradient (mean 525 MPa vs 325 MPa) and slightly higher yield, while C-ASF absorbed ~20-24% more energy because of its longer plateau, and the Goga viscoelastic model was validated for both series.
extraction_notes: 1) Text is Spanish; property names mapped as follows: Gqs (gradiente cuasi-elastico, ISO 13314 quasi-elastic gradient) -> modulus_mpa; Sry (tension relativa a compresion, 0.2% plastic strain) -> strength_mpa; Spl (tension plateau) -> plateau_stress_mpa; Eple (deformacion final del regimen plateau) -> densification_strain; W(Eple) -> energy_absorption_mj_m3. 2) Tables use the comma as decimal separator (e.g. '324,570' = 324.570 MPa); values transcribed with a decimal point. 3) measured_density_g_cc is NOT tabulated per sample. It was computed as (relative density from Tabla 5-11/5-12) x 2.70 g/cm3, the AA6063 density stated in Tabla 4-4. The results fall inside the ranges the paper states in text (T-ASF 1440-1623 kg/m3, C-ASF 1560-1670 kg/m3), so the derivation is consistent, but these are derived not directly quoted. Relative density is also recorded verbatim in microstructure_notes. 4) Total porosity (Tabla 5-11/5-12) is reported in microstructure_notes rather than matrix_porosity_fraction, because that column is the TOTAL foam porosity, not the unintended matrix/residual porosity. The paper gives residual/matrix porosity only as series averages (~10% for T-ASF, ~3% for C-ASF, Conclusion 4), so it was not attributed to individual samples and matrix_porosity_fraction is left null. 5) particle_true_density_g_cc is given only for the TPM nodules as a stated mean (820 kg/m3 = 0.820 g/cm3); for the Arlita nodules only ranges (700-870 kg/m3) are given, so it is left null. 6) Samples C-ASF01, C-ASF06, T-ASF05 and T-ASF07 were physically characterised but not compression tested; they are recorded with test_type 'other' and null mechanical properties. 7) Standalone compression tests on the nodules themselves (Tablas 5-2, 5-7 to 5-10, series ARL-NT/TT and TPM-NTV/TTV/NTH/TTH) are constituent-particle data, not hollow-particle-composite data, and are therefore not extracted as records. 8) Stress-strain curves (Figuras 5-74, 5-75) were not read off; only tabulated values were used. 9) Conductivity results (%IACS) have no schema field and were omitted. 10) All samples were annealed at 415 C / 180 min (AA6063-O) before testing.
